#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title and current date."""

import os
import tempfile
from datetime import date

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PDF_NAME = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE_STR = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")


def make_cover(output_path: str) -> None:
    width, height = letter
    c = canvas.Canvas(output_path, pagesize=letter)

    # Title (centered, bold, large)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    title_width = c.stringWidth(TITLE, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawString((width - title_width) / 2, height / 2 + 30, TITLE)

    # Date (centered, smaller)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    date_width = c.stringWidth(DATE_STR, "Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawString((width - date_width) / 2, height / 2 - 20, DATE_STR)

    c.save()


def main() -> None:
    if not os.path.exists(PDF_NAME):
        raise SystemExit(f"{PDF_NAME} not found in {os.getcwd()}")

    tmp_cover = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "cover.pdf")
    make_cover(tmp_cover)

    cover_reader = PdfReader(tmp_cover)
    report_reader = PdfReader(PDF_NAME)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(PDF_NAME, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    print(f"Added cover page ({TITLE!r}, {DATE_STR!r}) to {PDF_NAME}")
    print(f"Total pages now: {len(writer.pages)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
